header.title: Software should adapt to your business - not the other way around.
header.lead: Traditional software buying often starts with modules and licenses. NELIAS starts with the business itself: what you do, how you operate, and which capabilities matter most.

items.response: A unified platform approach for core management workflows.
Industry-aware configuration through the Sector Engine.
Connected workflows and progressively introduced automation.
Modular expansion of capabilities and capacity.
Shared data foundations and reporting capabilities.

differentiator.statement: NELIAS does not simply give businesses modules. It helps to understand their needs, compose their environment, and help streamline their processes.
